notes.title: Nyran Survivors Version 7.0
notes.notes:
Hello Mediators,

Here is the changelog for what is new and has been changed with version 7!

Changelog
Classes
Assassin

 Increased base block chance to 10%, up from 0%
 Increased base attack damage to 28, up from 26
 Fan of Daggers damage increased by 5%


Brood Mother

 Increased base vitality to 125, up from 116
 Shadowbolt damage increased by 20%
 Spiderling Swarm damage increased by 15%
 Web damage increased by 5%
 Shadow Aura damage increased by 5%


Death Knight

 Base vitality increased to 115, up from 105


Druid

 Increased base HPS to 2, up from 1
 Lunar Wrath damage increased by 10%
 Flower Garden damage increased by 10%
 Typhoon damage increased by 15%
 Nature Bolt damage increased by 20%


Gunslinger

 Increased base attack damage to 26, up from 24
 Increased base block chance to 10%, up from 0%
 Shoot Pistol damage increased by 10%
 Rapid Fire damage increased by 15%
 Shotgun Fire damage increased  by 20%
 Lob Grenade damage increased by 10%
 Lob Grenade damage radius increased to 8m, up from 7m


Paladin

 Increased base attack damage to 26, up from 25
 Increased base crit damage to 104%, up from 100%
 Ring of Light damage increased by 5%
 Shield Slam damage increased by 10%


Ranger

 Increased base attack damage to 28, up from 25
 Bow Shot damage increased by 15%
 Multi Shot damage increased by 10%


Elementalist

 Increased base attack damage to 29, up from 30
 Increased base critical damage to 105%, up from 100%


Warrior

 Increased base block chance to 10%, up from 0%
 Whirlwind spell damage increased by 5%


Wizard

 Increased base damage to 26, up from 25
 Orb of Wrath damage increased by 10%
 Dark Bolts damage increased by 10%
 North Winds buff duration increased to 3s, up from 2s


Wintercaller

 Increased Frost Shield damage by 20%
 Reduced the cooldown of Frost Shield to 14s, down from 16s
 Ice Blast damage by increased 5%
 Spiral Shards damage by increased 10%
 Base vitality increased to 128, up from 120


Spells
New

 Toxic Aura


Changes

 Epic Magnet Hands elite spell removed
 All Elite Spells now do the "Epic Magnet Hands" spell (gathers all XP from the level)
 Burning Blade damage increased by 30%
 Burning Blade damage width increased by 100%
 Burning Blade range increased to 26m, up from 20m
 Hammer Down spell range increased to 9m, up from 7m
 Savage Slash spell damage increased by 20%
 Fire Wave spell damage increased by 5%
 Shout of Shrill spell damage increased by 10%
 Shout of Vigor spell damage increased by 10%
 Tiger Stance now increases your current Critical Strike by 60%, up from 50%
 Drums of War now increases your current Haste by 60%, up from 50%
 Forked Lightning damage increased by 10%
 Frost Pillar damage increased by 20%
 Dagger Throw damage increased by 10%
 Volatile Spiderling damage increased by 20%
 Bleeding Slash no longer knocks enemies back
 Bleeding Slash damage increased by 5%
 Fire Strike damage increased by 5%


Engine

 Updated to Unity 2021.3.45f1 LTS, should see some performance gains
 Updated Unity packages
 Updated default font and default fallback of fonts


Gameplay

 All XP gains increased by 10%
 Increased the amount you collect from gold pickups by 100%
 All maps resource gains (gems and gold) increased by 10%
 Finishing a level now grants 2250 base gold, up from 2000
 Killing a boss will now grant 25 x [difficulty] gold (IE: Extreme = 125g per boss)
 Oleand Coast Skeleton Mage exp increased to 75, up from 70
 Oleand Coast Zombie 2 exp increased to 110, up from 100


Bug Fixes

 Gold from Treasure Goblin, Elites and Barrels will now always drop in the level bounds
 Potentially fixed a bug where enemy attacks could persist after death
 Fixed a potential memory leak on main menu and leaderboards
 Fixed a bug that caused Eenwyck and Thadwyck not rewarding the full amount of gold and gems



Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Nyran Survivors Version 6.0
notes.notes:
Hello Mediators,

With version 6, I decided to hold off on updating the game over smaller patches and make this update one giant patch. That's why it was a little quiet for some time.

Anyway, on to version 6! It's a big patch, lots of stuff got added and lots of stuff got fixed. Below is the changelog. 

Introducing, the Gunslinger
The Gunslinger – a new class wielding dual pistols. Unlockable after defeating The Interstice's final boss, this addition expands the playable classes to a total of 11.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/8ec392232af18c96a822bf5a99ed268314da76bb.png

New map, Oleand Coast
Venture to Oleand Coast to defeat 6 new bosses and new enemies. This map is automatically unlocked after defeating the last boss of The Interstice and is geared towards classes that have reached upgrade level 40.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/73f1a8dd05bfb4ed19a2e3ba4836c2b41fe919d4.png

New Items
2 new items have been added. Critical Strike chance + Cooldown reduction item and a healing item.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/a0b15437e403f6635bd59143067874423fb5f59b.png

New Spells
Version 6 has 3 new spells to add to your builds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/45188d78d0f302114faa2b5850509fdd0c044bd4.png

Better Feedback
The screen will flash red showing some feedback every time you get hit. This option can be turned off via the settings and is on by default. There is also a highlight outline that can be turned on, in case you lose your character. This setting is turned off by default and can be turned on via the settings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/54000dd3a27929e3e2fcf4b359db804fd3e9a645.png

Changelog
Map
New

 Oleand Coast


Class
New

 Gunslinger


Assassin

 Base Critical Damage increased to 12%, up from 10%


Ranger

 Bow Shot damage increased by 10%
 Bow Shot projectile speed increased to 25m/s, up from 20m/s
 Multi Shot projectile speed increased to 25m/s, up from 20m/s
 Multi Shot cone reduced slightly
 Bowshot multiple projectiles now spawns at the same time
 Bowshot spell hit sound effect changed
 Multi Shot spell hit sound effect added


Elementalist

 Earth Toss can now have multiple projectiles
 Earth Toss point light removed
 Frost Orb damage increased by 5%


Druid

 Nature Bolt projectile speed increased to 20m/s, up from 16m/s
 Nature Bolt combo finisher has a new animation


Death Knight

 Base Vitality increased to 105, up from 95


Brood Mother

 Spiderling Swarm now explodes when reaches the end of its spell range


Spells
New

 Explosive Chicken
 Dragon Punch
 Abyssal Rain


Changes

 Strike Again cone angle reduced slightly
 Volatile Spiderling now explodes when reaches the end of its spell range
 Frost Pillar damage increased by 10%
 Dagger Throw range increased by 10%
 All Wave spells damage increased by 20%
 Hermes Boots spell duration increased to 14s, up from 10s
 Shields Up! spell duration increased to 12s, up from 10s


Items
New

 Demon Heart epic item added, gain 2% crit and 2% cooldown
 Cherry Pie rare item added, heal 20% hp


Changes

 Pancakes now give 40% health, up from 20%


Engine

 Updated to Unity 2021.3.36f1 LTS, should see some performance gains
 Game and code optimizations, should see some performance gains


Gameplay

 Gold value now shows when picking up gold items
 Added a new option to settings that will now flash the screen when you take damage. This setting is on by default
 Added a new option to settings that will now highlight the player. This setting is off by default
 Added treasure goblin achievements
 Steam Deck limited to 40 fps
 There is now a limit on the number of damage numbers that can be showed at once. This caused a lot of lag at end game. Player damage numbers bypass this limit
 Health bars of enemies with Weakness applied will now show as purple
 Normal damage numbers delete time slightly reduced
 Main Menu UI important text is now highlighted in yellow
 Enemies no longer get knocked back if the spell will kill them
 Spell hit sound effects are now muted when on the death (or completion) screen



Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with damage numbers not correctly displaying when attacking an enemy with Weakness
 Fixed an issue with enemy spell beam spell collider
 Fixed an issue with gold coins sometimes not correctly adding to total gold gained at the end of a match
 Fixed an issue with Steam Overlay on the Death screen
 Fixed an issue with projectile delay not correctly applying
 Fixed an issue with Treasure Goblin sound effects
 Fixed a positional error in shoulder items on classes
 Fixed an issue with auto attack combos not reading the proper cooldown of their finishers before changing back
 Fixed a rare bug that caused the Health Potion not to be cast
 Fixed a rare bug that sometimes caused pickups to be picked up twice
 Fixed a rare bug that sometimes caused barrels to drop more than one gold drop
 Spider Queen Orb ability spawn position fixed
 Fixed a bug that caused multiple sound effects on an enemy spell to be played after the first cast on repeatable spells
 Fixed an issue that caused spell descriptions some times not fitting in the spell box in different languages
 Language fixes
 Fixed an issue with missing scripts on Windmere Pass level
 Fixed a bug with missing shaders and materials on elite/boss ragdolls (purple textures)
 Fixed a bug with deletion effect of enemies at the end of the round
 Deletion effect sound effect at the end of the round will now respect its audio settings volume
 Fixed a display issue with the game timer when retrying the map
 Fixed a bug with death mob spawn effects not properly deleting
 Fixed a visual bug with mob spawning boss spells


Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Nyran Survivors Version 5.0 - New Game Mode, Rush
notes.notes:
Hello Mediators,

30 minutes some times feels like a long time. So, Rush is here. Rush is a new game mode which is 15 minutes long, has increased xp rates and more. Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/82e3c7535e045b72d6cb0790d0f0358e1fcc8e09.png

Changelog

 New game mode, Rush
 Leaderboard inspect table now shows true damage rather than damage including overkill damage


Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Nyran Survivors Version 4.1 - Treasure Goblins!
notes.notes:
Hello Mediators,

Treasure Goblins are here, these little buggers have a small chance of spawning in a level. They run around the level dropping gold. If you manage to kill them, they will drop even more gold. If you don't, they will create a portal and disappear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/78d5065b3f2eb110673771e70bf3da79649ca873.png

Changelog

 Beating a level now gives you +2000 gold, up from +750g but it no longer stacks with resource gains from difficulty
 Gold drops gold value increased to 60g-90g, up from 20g-40g and no longer affected with resource gains from difficulty
 Treasure Goblins added, small chance to spawn throughout a level
 Increased the pickup radius of the gold drop item


Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!
